title: Work, Power & Energy

sections.heading: 1. Work-Energy Theorem
sections.proseLatex: Work done $= \vec{F}\cdot\vec{d}$. KE $= \frac{1}{2}mv^2$, PE $= mgh$. Work-energy theorem: $W_{\text{net}} = \Delta KE$.

keyFormulas.label: Work-Energy Theorem
keyFormulas.aiExplainContext: Net work equals change in kinetic energy.

sections.heading: 2. Conservation of Mechanical Energy
sections.proseLatex: When only conservative forces act, total mechanical energy is conserved.

workedExamples.problemLatex: A disc rolls up an incline with velocity $V$. Find max height.

wbjeebTraps: Rolling KE includes both translation and rotation.
